info.title: MICROSERVICE-PROD-Delete Customer By Subscription Id-spec
info.description: This API enables businesses to manage customer subscriptions efficiently. It provides functionality to delete a specific customer subscription using the unique identifiers of both the customer and the subscription. This endpoint is useful for service administrators and support teams who need to manage subscription lifecycles and remove subscriptions as necessary. By utilizing this API, users can ensure accurate maintenance of customer records and subscription statuses.

delete.summary: Remove a subscription for a customer.
delete.description: This endpoint allows you to delete a specific subscription for a customer identified by their unique ID. Ensure that you have the correct subscription ID before performing this action, as it cannot be undone.

requestBody.description: Request body for deleting a specific subscription associated with a customer. This operation requires the subscription identifier and may include additional information necessary to process the deletion request.

DeleteCustomerBySubscriptionIdRequest.description: A string representation of the request body for deleting a subscription.

metadata.description: Contains metadata related to the response.

DeleteCustomerBySubscriptionIdResponse_2.description: Response schema for the DELETE operation on a specific customer's subscription, indicating successful processing.
